domain: Structural Dynamics / Constraint Theory / Social Systems
topic_summary: Analysis of three constraint dynamics extracted from a formal network specification: fragmented knowledge inheritance creating differential extraction by structural position, systemic resource depletion benefiting institutional actors, and transactional intimacy as universally extractive coordination failure. The formalization demonstrates indexical variance in constraint experience and transformation pathways blocked by inter-constraint dependencies.

key_entities: Analytical observer position (detects extraction others normalize)
key_tensions: Meaning-seekers vs meaning-brokers (fragmentation as Snare vs Rope)
Vitality extraction vs institutional benefit (barren environment differential)
Transactional coordination vs asymmetric extraction (mechanical intimacy)
Collective organization vs fragmentation maintenance (transformation blocking)
Natural scarcity perception vs constructed extraction (Type I error)

omegas.description: Does the chi formula (ε × π × σ) correctly capture extraction magnitude, or does it systematically under/over-weight certain index combinations? The formalization assumes multiplicative composition but provides no empirical validation.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) — chi formula is the analytical medium

omegas.description: Are the type classification thresholds (rope ≤0.35, tangled_rope 0.46-0.70, snare >0.70) empirically grounded or arbitrary? Different threshold values would reclassify constraints without changing underlying structure.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — no threshold derivation provided in formalization

omegas.description: How are power index values assigned (analytical=1.15, moderate=1.0, powerless=1.5, institutional=-0.2)? The formalization treats these as given but they determine all downstream classifications. Who benefits from this particular power scale?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) — power index assignment is unexamined structural choice

omegas.description: Is Boltzmann test failure (non-factorizable burden distribution) sufficient to prove constructed constraint, or could natural constraints also exhibit indexical variance under certain conditions? The formalization assumes factorizability = natural law.
omegas.source: F03 (Hasty Generalization) — mountain classification based on single test

omegas.description: The transformation rules specify preconditions but not probability of execution. Are the blocked_by relationships absolute barriers or merely high-cost pathways? The formalization treats blocking as binary.
omegas.source: Deferred axis transformation_blocking_topology — circular dependency resolution mechanism unclear

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected: indexical_extraction_variance classified as mountain (unchangeable measurement framework) but the chi formula itself is a constructed analytical tool, not a natural law. The formalization provides no empirical validation of the multiplicative composition or threshold values. Generated omega_chi_formula_validity and omega_threshold_calibration to bound this uncertainty. The mountain classification may be a piton of analytical convention rather than physical constraint.
